rss: Budget to include £1bn for social and affordable housing
title: New Homes for Everyone!
story: In the world of BizKid, a big plan is underway to build more houses so everyone has a cozy place to live. This means more families can find homes without spending too much money.
storyBig: BizKid World is investing a huge amount to ensure more affordable homes are available to families. This initiative aims to make housing accessible for everyone, boosting the construction industry and helping families secure affordable living spaces.
think: Why do you think having affordable homes is important for families?
bull: More homes mean more jobs for builders and happier families!
bear: Building new homes takes time, and we need to be patient.

rss: L'Oreal says weight loss drugs are impacting beauty and skincare sales
title: New Trends Change Candy Sales!
story: In BizKid World, people are choosing healthier snacks, and this is making candy less popular. Some folks are trying new things to stay healthy, which means candy makers are thinking of fun ways to get kids excited about sweets again!
storyBig: In BizKid World, healthier snack choices are impacting candy sales, leading to changes in consumer preferences. Candy makers are exploring innovative strategies to appeal to health-conscious kids while maintaining their sweet treats' popularity.
think: What other healthy snacks could candy companies make?
bull: Trying new snacks can be fun and healthy!
bear: Less candy sales might mean fewer sugary treats to share.
